name: FFT Lab
desc: A discrete-Fourier-transform lab: four harmonic-amplitude sliders drive the signal, with the magnitude spectrum, dominant bin and Parseval check shown live.
controls: Four harmonic-amplitude sliders, four presets (sine/square/saw/chord), log-scale and phase toggles; keys 1–4 load presets, L toggles log scale, P toggles phase
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
